name: Toulmin Argumentation Model

source_original.purpose: Pengujian struktur mikro-argumen (*Claim, Grounds/Data, Warrant, Backing, Qualifier, Rebuttal*)
source_original.inputs: Pernyataan klaim strategis dan kumpulan bukti pendukung
source_original.outputs: Dekonstruksi 6 elemen Toulmin dan identifikasi celah *warrant* logika

activation_conditions: User requests Toulmin Argumentation Model or the orchestrator justifies it against the problem.
methodology: Make the connecting warrant explicit and identify backing
State the qualifier and strongest rebuttal conditions
Test unsupported warrants and alternate explanations before endorsement
tool_requirements: Host reasoning and resource reading; calculation tool when required.
evidence_requirements: Cite material claims; mark missing inputs UNKNOWN; do not reuse illustrative source conclusions.
limitations: Host-authored analysis requires behavioral evaluation; schema validity does not prove truth.
validation_criteria: Provide claim or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide grounds or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide warrant or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide backing or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide qualifier or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide rebuttal or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide gaps or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Use all distinctive methodology steps and identify missing evidence.
